result.summary: Found 2 layout issues: truncated restaurant names in the Fastest near you carousel and incomplete bottom navigation labels.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off mid-word under the third card in Fastest near you, making the full name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure card width and text wrapping show the complete restaurant name.

issues.description: Bottom tab bar shows incomplete or missing labels: Orders has no visible icon above it, and the Orders/Profile area looks misaligned or partially blank compared to Home and Search.
issues.suggestion: Ensure every tab has a proper icon and fully visible label, with consistent spacing and alignment across the tab bar.
